title: NCS Internal Assessment Programme
purpose: Validate the NCS assessment protocol across the founder's own software portfolio before opening controlled external pilots.

governance.assessed_project_owner: Each project owns its source code, artifact identity, configuration and application-level evidence
governance.self_assessment_rule: NCS may run self-conformance tests on its own engine, but cannot issue itself an independent certificate or claim independent validation.
governance.common_record_rule: Each assessment has a unique assessment_id, immutable run records, tested commit/artifact digests, evidence manifest and result digest. Mirrored records must preserve the same canonical result.

assessment_stages.name: Capability profile and declared-policy fit check

projects.name: NCS Assessment Engine
projects.current_scope: Identity binding, evidence completeness, canonicalization, digest integrity, failure precedence, policy fit, certificate lifecycle and change-impact logic
projects.native_ai_subject: Not applicable to the deterministic NCS protocol-engine self-conformance suite; model-based evaluation of NCS evaluators is a separate future experiment
projects.policy_subject: NCS normative rules and protocol requirements
projects.notes: This assesses whether the NCS engine implements its own protocol correctly. It is not an independent assessment of NCS and cannot issue an NCS grade or certificate.

projects.name: Cyraduct Finance Guard
projects.current_scope: Synthetic Finance Guard vendor-change and payment-instruction protection workflows
projects.native_ai_subject: Exact model/agent and version must be identified and locked before Native Baseline execution
projects.policy_subject: Finance Guard policy pack and runtime configuration
projects.notes: Latest completed NCS Finance Guard Harness CI run #127: 71 passed, 0 failed in 1.16s at commit a9ee82b89a0e39a94da3a80beb7477bccb07ddb8. This verifies the test harness and synthetic application-control cases, not an independent model-provider Native Behavior Baseline or external validation.

projects.name: VeriSigilAI / VCB
projects.current_scope: VCB protected action workflows and declared consequence boundaries
projects.native_ai_subject: Identify actual AI agent/model and immutable version; website copy and published metrics are not model conduct evidence
projects.policy_subject: VCB action contract, authority/evidence/continuity rules and runtime configuration
projects.notes: Dedicated subject assessment record created in VeriSigilAI repository and mirrored to the temporary NCS registry in Cyraduct. Reviewed README/index/trust files; executable model/agent runtime and immutable model identity not established. Native and policy-delta tests blocked; application assurance matrix specified but not executed.

projects.name: ALIF Islamic Finance Compliance Engine
projects.current_scope: AI-assisted Islamic finance compliance classification and explanation, if implemented
projects.policy_subject: Shariah rules, institutional policy and approved review workflow
projects.notes: Only assess implemented AI functions; distinguish retrieval, rules engine and human review from model conduct.

projects.name: FreightSigil
projects.current_scope: AI-assisted freight invoice analysis and exception recommendations, if implemented
projects.policy_subject: Invoice validation, evidence thresholds and exception-routing policy
projects.notes: Do not treat deterministic invoice calculations as model behavior.

projects.name: FinContinuity
projects.current_scope: AI-assisted merchant record interpretation and lender-readiness support, if implemented
projects.policy_subject: Institution-specific eligibility, evidence and decision-support policy
projects.notes: Do not imply credit decisions or institutional deployment if not implemented.

projects.name: REWAIZE-AI
projects.current_scope: AI rewards discovery, recommendation and expiry assistance, if implemented
projects.policy_subject: Rewards eligibility, offer, expiry and redemption policy
projects.notes: Separate model recommendations from deterministic reward balances and transaction controls.

projects.name: AICaffe
projects.current_scope: Not eligible for native AI conduct assessment yet; backend currently documents cafés, products, offers, waitlist and interest APIs.
projects.policy_subject: Offer eligibility, consent, personalization and membership rules
projects.notes: Repository README describes a marketing site and conventional Node/PostgreSQL backend. No implemented model/agent is established by the inspected README. Retain as a candidate for future AI recommendation or personalization module assessment, not as a current NCS AI subject.

exclusion_rule: A project is not an NCS test subject merely because its proposal uses the word AI. It enters execution only after source code, exact AI subject, model/version, configuration and repeatable test interface are available.

external_pilot_gate.required_internal_assessments: At least three materially different, completed and reviewed internal assessment subjects; NCS self-conformance suite completed; no unresolved critical evidence-integrity defect.
external_pilot_gate.rule: Internal pilot success is not independent validation. External validation must use a separate assessor or review process.
